item.summary: improve(ui): header scope dropdown and unchanged-line expansion in session diff (#122711) * feat(ui): expand session diff navigation Release note: Make the session diff scope selectable from its header and let working-tree diffs reveal unchanged file context in bounded chunks. * fix(ui): keep unchanged-line expander labels inside their row Chromium's flex layout on button elements pins the label line box to the button's vertical center, painting the gap count into the diff row above. Grid centering avoids the quirk; skip rows also center-align their controls. * fix(ui): revalidate diff snapshot before expanding unchanged lines Addresses the ClawSweeper P2 stale collapsed-gap content finding by revalidating the target file patch before reading current file text.
